import math
import sys

def main():
    data = input().split()
    x = float(data[0])
    y = float(data[1])
    n = int(data[2])
    
    target = x / y
    p = 0
    s = 1
    minError = float('inf')
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        val = target * i
        candidates = [math.floor(val), math.ceil(val)]
        
        for candidate in candidates:
            error = abs(target - candidate / i)
            if error < minError:
                minError = error
                p = int(candidate)
                s = i
    
    print(f"{p}/{s}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
